title: ICSI Seeks Inclusion of CS as Authorised Representatives Before ATFE
content:
# ICSI Seeks Inclusion of CS as Authorised Representatives Before ATFE

Ek important update hai for all Company Secretaries! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Appellate Tribunal for Foreign Exchange (ATFE) ke saamne Company Secretaries in Practice ko Authorised Representatives ke roop mein shamil karne ke liye request kiya hai.

ICSI President CS Pawan G. Chandak ne Revenue Secretary ko July 24, 2026, ko ek representation bheja hai. Iss request ka aim hai ki Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) mein amendment kiya jaye, specifically Section 32 mein, taaki Practising Company Secretaries bhi ATFE ke saamne clients ko represent kar sakein.

Currently, Section 32 of FEMA, 1999, mein sirf legal practitioners aur Chartered Accountants ko hi Special Director (Appeals) ke saamne representation ki anumati hai.

**Key Highlights of ICSI's Request:**
*   **What:** ICSI ne Appellate Tribunal for Foreign Exchange (ATFE) ke saamne Company Secretaries in Practice ko Authorised Representatives ke taur par shamil karne ki maang ki hai.
*   **Why:** Company Secretaries already several other forums jaise NCLT, NCLAT, CCI, SAT, RERA Authorities, TDSAT, aur various tax, regulatory and adjudicating authorities ke saamne stakeholders ko represent karte hain. They possess expertise in FEMA, related laws, compliance, and cross-border transactions.
*   **Reference:** The representation is dated July 24, 2026, with reference number G&CL: ATFE: JUL26.

ICSI believes ki isse professional participation badhega, access to justice improve hoga, aur efficient adjudication mein madad milegi.
